  - text: CLASS 9 · REAL NUMBERS
  - heading "Nth Roots and Radical Meaning" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Interpret nth roots as inverse powers and explore real-root behaviour.
  - text: 18 min INTERMEDIATE CONCEPT KEY IDEA
  - link "School lessons":

  - main:
    - heading "POWER–ROOT MACHINE ⓘ" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Choose a base (a) and an index (n). See repeated factors, the power aⁿ, and the real root (principal value).
    - text: BASE (a)
    - button "−"
    - strong: "-8"
    - button "+"
    - text: INDEX (n)
    - button "−"
    - strong: "3"
    - button "+"
    - text: INDEX TYPE
    - button "Odd (allows all real a)"
    - button "Even (needs a ≥ 0)"
    - text: RESET
    - button:
      - img
    - article:
      - heading "1. REPEATED FACTORS" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Multiply a by itself n times.
      - text: "-8× -8× -8 -8 × -8 × -8"
    - text: →
    - article:
      - heading "2. POWER (aⁿ)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The result of the multiplication.
      - text: (-8)
      - superscript: "3"
      - text: = -512
    - text: →
    - article:
      - heading "3. REAL ROOT (ⁿ√a)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The principal real root b such that bⁿ = a.
      - superscript: "3"
      - text: "√-8 = -2 Check: (-2)3 = -8 ✓"
    - article:
      - heading "ODD INDEX (n = 3)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: All real numbers are allowed.
      - text: "-2 -16 -8 0 8 16 ∛(−8) = −2"
    - article:
      - heading "EVEN INDEX (n = 4)" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Only a ≥ 0 has real roots.
      - text: 2 -16 -8 0 8 16 ⁴√16 = 2
    - article:
      - heading "THE RULE" [level=3]
      - text: ⁿ√a = b means bⁿ = a.
      - paragraph: • If n is odd, a can be any real number.
      - paragraph: • If n is even, a must be ≥ 0 in the real numbers.
    - article:
      - heading "EXAMPLES" [level=3]
      - paragraph:
        - img
        - text: ∛(−8) = −2 because (−2)³ = −8.
      - paragraph:
        - img
        - text: ⁴√16 = 2 because 2⁴ = 16 (principal real root).
    - article:
      - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=3]:
        - img
        - text: COMMON MISCONCEPTION
      - paragraph: Writing ± for the radical symbol confuses a principal root with solutions of x² = a.
      - paragraph: We use the principal real root.
    - article:
      - heading "ⓘ WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: An nth root undoes a power.
      - text: a → aⁿ → ⁿ√a = b bⁿ = a
      - paragraph: For even n, negative numbers have no real root because no real number, when raised to an even power, becomes negative.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - text: "1"
      - paragraph: Find ∛(−8). We need b³ = −8.
      - text: ∛(−8) = −2 2
      - paragraph: Find ⁴√16. We need b ≥ 0 with b⁴ = 16.
      - text: ⁴√16 = 2
    - heading "MINI CHALLENGE" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Match each power with its correct root (principal real root).
    - text: 1 (−27)³
    - combobox "1 (−27)³":
      - option "∛(−27)³ = −27" [selected]
      - option "⁴√5⁴ = 5"

    - text: 2 5⁴

      - option "⁴√5⁴ = 5" [selected]
      - option "√81² = 81"
      - option "∛(−16)³ = −16"
    - text: 3 81²
    - combobox "3 81²":
      - option "∛(−27)³ = −27"
      - option "⁴√5⁴ = 5"
      - option "√81² = 81" [selected]

    - text: 4 (−16)³
